Sources: system/drawings/draft_electrical_block_diagram.svg; devices/controllers_power READMEs (DP-13, DP-28, DP-29, DP-30). Device-level circuits (Topedal board, Hall boards, coil boards) are in their own device folders.

Not defined and therefore not drawn: mains supply to DP-27 / DP-25, GND bar location, all TBD ratings and values, coil-to-driver and switch-to-input assignments, sensor return path and output type, charge LED drive.

Open source conflict: DP-28 README states 8 direct switch inputs per board; the block diagram states J1 = 7 direct inputs. Count left off this drawing. 18 coils use 18 of the 24 driver channels (3 boards x 8).
